claims: C1 scopes should be recorded in a semi-structured format
C2 the semi-structured format is exemplified by a ScopeOfAutonomy record with fields allowed_tools, latest_time, max_cost, tool_constraints, and additional_details
C3 the purpose of recording scopes in this format is to facilitate validation, enforcement, and auditing by the platform

concepts.name: scope_of_autonomy
concepts.gloss: S is a clear, mutually understood boundary defining which sub-goals the assistant may pursue, acceptable side effects, and when the assistant must pause for clarification or approval

concepts.name: semi_structured_scope_record
concepts.gloss: R is a record of a scope of autonomy in a semi-structured format, such as a ScopeOfAutonomy record with fields allowed_tools, latest_time, max_cost, tool_constraints, and additional_details

concepts.name: scope_record_of
concepts.gloss: record R records scope of autonomy S
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of recording scopes in a format, so a relation between a record and the scope it records is needed

concepts.name: platform_validation_enforcement_auditing
concepts.gloss: the platform can validate, enforce, and audit the scope recorded in R
concepts.inference: the clause states the purpose of the format is to facilitate validation, enforcement, and auditing by the platform; this is expressed as a property of the record

ontology.gloss: R is a semi-structured record of a scope of autonomy

asserts.read_back: recording scope % in a semi-structured format is preferred, because it facilitates validation, enforcement, and auditing by the platform

closure.reason: the clause states a preference for recording scopes in a semi-structured format; it does not forbid any way of recording a scope, so silence leaves other recording methods permitted
